task.description: HARD GATE on DATA-DESIGNER's docs/agents/design/REQ-033.md, per WF-02 Step 1b. Read the artefact itself, not DATA-DESIGNER's handoff summary. Check each of REQ-033's 9 acceptance criteria against the artefact: does a concrete design element address it, with no TBD/deferral language on anything that is this requirement's job to resolve? Verify no implementation code is present (no .ts code blocks with real logic bodies -- types/shapes/pseudocode-level structure only). Verify the two open questions the requirement explicitly required to stay open (the FR-4 'configurable per event' eligibility rule, routed to REQ-038; and the code-shape composition ambiguities the artefact itself surfaced) are genuinely left open with the resolver named, not silently resolved. Verify the entropy arithmetic (26 chars x 5 bits/char = 130 bits) is correct and actually shown, not merely asserted. Verify the FK closure (registrations.invite_code_id -> invite_codes.id, onDelete restrict) is stated precisely enough for BACKEND-DEV to write the migration without inventing anything.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-033's 9 acceptance criteria maps to a concrete design element in REQ-033.md, cited by section.
No implementation code (real .ts logic bodies) appears anywhere in the artefact -- structure/types/shapes only.
The FR-4 eligibility open question is confirmed genuinely unresolved in the artefact (not quietly answered) and is explicitly routed to REQ-038.
The entropy arithmetic is independently recomputed, not merely re-read, and confirmed correct.
FAIL cites the specific acceptance criterion or check that failed; PASS states what was independently checked.
